evals.name: Free-form does not invent AC
evals.prompt: Normalize this ask: we need dual approval for credit releases somehow.
evals.expected_output: requirements.md with Goal filled, Acceptance criteria '(none in source — see Open questions)', Open questions listing missing threshold/persona/process.

assertions.name: no_invented_ac
assertions.description: Acceptance criteria section does not invent Given/When/Then bullets absent from the source.

assertions.name: open_questions_present
assertions.description: Open questions has at least one concrete gap (threshold, process area, or similar).

evals.name: Unresolved ticket still produces requirements
evals.prompt: Intake ticket PROJ-999 for credit release dual approval (assume adapter unavailable).
evals.expected_output: Source ticket-unresolved:PROJ-999; requirements written; open question about adapter; no fake backlinked backlog item.

assertions.name: ticket_unresolved_source
assertions.description: requirements.md Source field contains ticket-unresolved:PROJ-999 (or equivalent).

assertions.name: no_backlog_draft
assertions.description: Skill does not create a Jira work item with FTS backlink fields filled.
